publisher.name: Lobbying Disclosure Act public disclosure system

dataset.name: LD-1 and LD-2 filings
dataset.description: Registration and lobbying-activity filing versions with filing-level money, participants, activities, and related disclosures.

acquisition.pagination: Offset pages reached through next URLs; accepted page size is 25; a query parameter is required beyond page one; partitions require a convergence pass.

partitions.name: posted_date
partitions.source: dt_posted selected with strict before/after filters and filtered locally
partitions.purpose: Overlapping incremental discovery only; not fact identity or reporting time.

acquisition.retry_policy: Bound retries, honor Retry-After on 429, checkpoint complete pages, and never publish a failed page as an empty result.

physical_schema.null_policy: Preserve absent, explicit null, empty string, empty array, and invalid typed values as distinct states.
physical_schema.schema_fingerprint: Sorted observed JSON paths with JSON kinds and array cardinality, plus this contract version and the reviewed OpenAPI override set.

identity.occurrence_locator: snapshot digest + normalized request + page number + one-based results ordinal
identity.record_version: filing_uuid + SHA-256 of canonical record JSON
identity.duplicate_policy: Preserve every occurrence; conflicting content for one UUID creates separate record versions and blocks the affected projection.

time_fields.meaning: Publisher reporting interval; preserve source code and display.
Publisher posting timestamp with source UTC offset.
Reported relationship termination date; does not erase the filing.
Effective date asserted for the client relationship.
Current nested registrant master update timestamp, not historical filing time.

money_fields.meaning: Source-reported lobbying income point when the API supplies a decimal; its measurement is a method- and period-specific good-faith estimate, while API null remains ambiguous until document evidence establishes an amount state.
money_fields.unit: USD lossless reported decimal or document-qualified band

money_fields.meaning: Source-reported lobbying expense point when the API supplies a decimal; its measurement and precision depend on the reporting method and period, while API null remains ambiguous until document evidence establishes an amount state.
money_fields.unit: USD lossless reported decimal or document-qualified band

code_fields.meaning: Filing state and period family from the pinned filing-types constants snapshot.
Raw expense calculation method; observed uppercase codes conflict with lowercase OpenAPI enums.
General lobbying issue code from the pinned constants snapshot.

rules: Do not add income and expenses into one universal amount.
Do not infer daily transactions from filing-period amounts.

Preserve reported_value, threshold_band, source_blank, not_applicable, invalid, and unobserved money states; record printable-document absence as the unobserved reason, and never turn API null or a checked under-5000 band into zero or an invented point amount.
Treat a losslessly parsed API decimal as a reported point, not proof of exact economic money; retain reporting method, effective precision rule, and any derived interval separately.
Preserve filing-level as-filed registrant fields and printable-document assertions separately from nested mutable master profiles.
Preserve API lobbying-activity occurrences separately from printable form groups; an LD-1 API object per issue code can duplicate one shared form section and must not cause double-counting.
Preserve standardized API government-entity IDs and labels separately from agency text printed as filed.
Classify pre-2021-02-14 government-entity associations as filing_scope unless stronger source evidence establishes activity scope.
A no-activity or termination code does not delete money or other disclosed content.

revisions.publisher_model: Originals, amendments, terminations, termination amendments, and no-activity variants have distinct filing UUIDs; no amends_filing_uuid is published.
revisions.effective_projection: Blocked while draft. Preserve every version; any later effective chain is a named inference validated against printable documents.

checks.rule: Every normalized filing has a valid non-null UUID.
Every results occurrence becomes a record version or an explicit issue.
Income, expenses, and expense method retain raw API values, measurement rules, and document-qualified amount states without being combined or imputed.
Missing documents and API/document differences publish as explicit unobserved, representation-only, normalized-difference, or conflict states.
Every child-array element retains its JSON locator and content digest.
Legacy imported government entities never publish as activity-scoped relationships.
Additive unknown fields are captured and included in schema-drift evidence.

scenarios: API null expense with printable under-threshold state
API null expense with printable under-threshold state
API null expense with printable under-threshold state

use.retention: Preserve complete API responses, record occurrences, source documents selected by policy, and every accepted version indefinitely.
use.disclaimer: Senate Office of Public Records cannot vouch for the data or analyses derived from these data after the data have been retrieved from LDA.gov.
